# `not-compared`

Parts of the spec that weren't compared

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `not-compared` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Spec and engine notices ([RULES.md section 11](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

Notice for parts of the spec that weren't compared: webhooks, callbacks, `$ref`s to external URLs, and ignored exclusions.

## Why this default

So nothing is skipped silently.

## Example

From test case [`callbacks-not-compared`](../../test/cases/callbacks-not-compared/): Callbacks are out of scope; one notice says so.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  not-compared: info
```
